definition.name: column-hilbert-inner-product-displays
definition.definition: Byte-matched from refs/kitaev-2405.02434/approximate_algebras.tex: level one (tex:1125-1132, lem_PQ_Hilb displays): Y^\dag\cdot X=\braket{Y}{X}\,\wt{Q} (X,Y in S_{P,Q}), Y^\dag\cdot X=\Co_{Q}(Y^{\dag}X), \wt{Q}=\Co_Q(Q); |\braket{X}{X}-||X||^2| <= O(\delta+\eps)||X||^2. Extended (tex:1547-1549, 1dQ_ip_ext): Y^\dag\cdot X=\braket{Y}{X}\,\wt{Q} (X,Y in M_{n,1} tensor S_{P,Q}) with \braket{Y}{X}=\sum_l \braket{[Y]_{l1}}{[X]_{l1}}. NOTE: the normalization factor is \wt{Q}=\Co_Q(Q) (NOT any u_Q); the false 1dQ_ip_norm_ext (tex:1551-1554) is NOT provisioned — its corrected squared form is the validated lem-hcb-column-hilbert-squared external.
